course: Granite Ridge Golf Club - Cobalt Course (Milton, Ontario, Canada)
facility: Granite Ridge Golf Club, 9503 Dublin Line, Milton, ON L9T 2X7
courseIdentification: COBALT course only. The facility has two separate 18-hole courses: Cobalt (par 72) and Ruby (par 70). Data below is Cobalt, taken from the club's own 'Cobalt Course' scorecard graphic. Ruby's card was pulled separately and confirmed to be a different, par-70 layout (Blue 5747), so there is no cross-contamination here.
notes:
PRIMARY SOURCE: the operator's own scorecard image, linked from golfgranite.com/golf/cobalt-course/ (uploaded 2025-02-05; the club's media library contains only two scorecard files, Cobalt and Ruby, so this is the current published card). Every per-hole yardage was read at 4x zoom and independently reconciled against the printed OUT / IN / TOTAL subtotals on the card - all five tee sets sum exactly. Par (36/36/72) and the stroke-index allocation (odds on the front nine, evens on the back, 1-18 each used once) also validate. 

CROSS-CHECK: GolfPass's hole-by-hole table reproduces the identical 18 Blue yardages, pars and stroke indexes (Blue 2961/3327/6288). Two sources agree on the per-hole data. 

KNOWN DISCREPANCY - TWO GENERATIONS OF CARD. Several databases still carry an older, longer measurement of Cobalt: Blue 6546, White 5952, Red 5077 (Golf Canada, mScorecard, InteGolf, and GolfPass's own tee-set summary table, which contradicts GolfPass's own hole-by-hole table on the same page). The current club card is Blue 6288. Use the 6288 generation for the scorecard screen; the 6546 figures are stale. 

KNOWN DISCREPANCY - STROKE INDEX. Golf Canada files a different SI allocation than the printed card: GC = 15,7,17,11,3,5,1,9,13 / 6,8,12,16,4,2,18,10,14; printed card = 15,11,13,5,3,9,1,17,7 / 8,16,12,10,4,2,18,6,14. They agree only on holes 1,5,7,12,14,15,16,18. The printed-card values are used above (club card + GolfPass agree); the Golf Canada variant is recorded here so it can be swapped in if you post scores through Golf Canada. 

RATINGS CAVEAT. The club's printed card shows NO course/slope rating. The rating/slope values above are Golf Canada's published ratings, and their tee names match the card exactly, but they are filed against the older longer measurement (see ratingFiledAtYards / ratingMatchesPrintedCard - none of them match the printed totals). Treat them as the correct values for handicap posting but not as a rating of the 6288-yard card. 18Birdies separately lists Cobalt at 6288 yds with rating 69.6 / slope 118, which would be a rating of the current card, but I could not confirm that against an official rating body, so it is not used above. Golf Canada also marks every Cobalt tee isActive=false, which may indicate the ratings are pending revision. 

SOURCE REJECTED: golfify.io's 'Granite Ridge Golf Club - Cobalt' page publishes a par-70, 5973-yard layout with completely different hole yardages. Cobalt is par 72. That page is the Ruby course (or a variant of it) mislabelled as Cobalt - a clear example of the two courses being conflated. Do not use it. 

NOTE ON HYBRID TEES: 'Blue/White Hybrid' and 'White/Red Hybrid' are combination tee sets printed on the club card; each hole plays from either the Blue or the White (resp. White or Red) marker. They are real, separately-rated tee sets, not interpolations.
